title: mut.concept_relational_aesthetics
mutation_directive: Channel Nicolas Bourriaud's RELATIONAL AESTHETICS (1998) — art whose substrate is human relation, social context, encounter. Translate to digital: the piece must respond to a SECOND viewer or external presence — open a WebSocket to a public broadcast (e.g. wss://stream.binance.com price ticker, public chat relay), or use BroadcastChannel API so multiple browser tabs of the piece on the same machine influence each other in real time. The visual reflects the SHARED state, not a private one. Display the count of active connections / external pulses in the corner. The work is the SOCIAL FIELD it creates, not the pixels.
